messages:
jordan: @here heads-up: we're scheduling a rolling maintenance tonight 23:00 UTC -> 02:00 UTC. Concrete plan: staggered node reboots across two cohorts to rotate NIC firmware and linux kernel updates on GPU hosts in us-east1 (cohort A) and eu-west1 (cohort B). Expect transient capacity dip ~3-7% per region while draining.

maya: timeline + impact acked. which pools are in cohort A?

jordan: cohort A = saturn-pool-{1..4}, gradient-pool-2. cohort B = saturn-edge-{a..c}, figurehead-pool. full list in the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/rolling-reboots-7070

kevin: ops note — we'll run normal drain -> reboot -> kv-cache warmup to avoid cold-reference latency. Will seed prefix caches immediately after restart with kv-seed job.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: id=maint-7070; start=2026-03-21T23:00:00Z; end=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z; regions=[us-east1,eu-west1]

liam: quick Q: will dedicated customers on reserved pools be moved or will we evict? We should avoid evicting reserved vclusters.

jordan: reserved pools will be excluded from forced eviction; we'll cordon/evacuate only interruptible/spot and best-effort tenants. If anyone needs special handling ping me now.

emily: can the cost team confirm spot-backfill spend? we might see an extra ~$2k/hr for the burst windows — want to pre-approve.

kevin: cost estimate attached — rough calc: 120 extra vGPU-hours in us-east1 + 80 in eu-west1 -> ~ $1,900 for the night. We have an allocation split policy: infra covers 50% of urgent patches, product covers the rest for scheduled non-critical work. ping @finance for final sign-off.

maya: plan to avoid batch training submissions from infra teams between 22:30-01:00. I'll put a short banner on the internal cluster dashboard.

jordan: canaries: will bring up two canary racks in each region, run 1% synthetic traffic against hosted endpoints to verify KV/latency. If canaries fail we will roll back and requeue.

liam: drain command for reference:

```
# drain node with graceful evict
./clusterctl cordon node-1234 && ./clusterctl drain node-1234 --evict-local-storage=false --grace-period=120
```

kevin: after reboot run kv-warmup job:

```
kubectl run kv-seed-7070 --image=internal/kv-seeder:stable --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/seed --pools=saturn-pool-1,saturn-pool-2 --rate=200
```

emily: acked. finance looped in. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — please react :eyes: when you've read. will update if schedule shifts. if we hit unexpected egresstests failing we'll post to #incidents and roll forward rollback playbook.

maya: reading :eyes:

liam: reading :eyes:

kevin: noted. i'll be on call 22:30-02:30
